scope: Technical rendered review of representative unchanged/new physical presentation only; no human artistic, whole-game, weather or performance acceptance.
review_method: All67actual captures inspected via four contact sheets; staff/bypass/court additionally inspected individually. Eight representative source images retained in the published packet to bound evidence size.

images.observation: Retained occupied room, furnishings, resident and companion render together with registered surfaces; lighting/readability and game feel are not artistically accepted.
Retained mail doors and labels render against their wall; this is the existing stock, not Claude's pending refit, and it grants no mail interaction acceptance.
Retained register/crank are visible in a dark corridor; this is the old installed stock, not the pending refit. Full inspection-camera behavior is not proven.
Deeper staff cistern brackets visibly reach their tile receiving wall; glaze and wood remain distinct. Lid-edge shadow aliasing is visible and not artistically accepted.

Existing vertical vent remains exposed and the offset support is seated beside it; lower supply geometry is partly hidden by the cistern, so this pose is not comprehensive optical proof of every bend.

Actual factory delivery-court endpoint after eight connected controller legs: receiving paving, recessed door, brick and glazed sash are visible with the companion. Scenic-door use and a whole-building journey are not accepted.
Retained roof tank keeps its complete body, supports and roof context; this posed daylight image is not a distance-LOD or performance acceptance.
Original night lighting shows the city and occupied window depth with the factory tower silhouette. Dark roof interiors, repeated distant silhouettes and sky artistic qualification remain open.

remaining_limits: Some unchanged inspection views are poor: the dumbwaiter camera is wall-occluded; that image grants no appearance acceptance.
The new lower vent-bypass supply remains partly concealed in the runtime view; native views/contacts and strict loaded checks are separate evidence.
Stair-stepped cistern lid shadows and distant repetitive city massing remain visual debt.
No weather annual artistic acceptance or playable-frame performance result.
